name: breadcrumbs
title: Breadcrumbs
description: Launcher for the Breadcrumbs box-sprint timer. The macOS app owns the timer; these commands talk to it over breadcrumbs:// URLs.
author: opslab

commands.name: start-sprint
commands.title: Start Sprint
commands.description: Start a box sprint in Breadcrumbs

commands.name: pause-resume
commands.title: Pause/Resume Sprint
commands.description: Pause or resume the running sprint

commands.name: todays-boxes
commands.title: Today's Boxes
commands.description: Show today's ticked boxes and open History
